defaults.setup: Place the referenced literal Workflow Definition fixture at <temporary-project>/breakdown.yaml on a supported local filesystem.
defaults.action: Call validate_workflow through the packaged core dispatcher with the temporary project as the explicit root.

rows.oracle: Only project-root breakdown.yaml is read; the parsed value identifies breakdown.workflow.v1 and contains no Run fields.
Every accepted and forbidden YAML/UTF-8 form returns the literal success or ordered diagnostic oracle in the Workflow corpus.
Required root fields are accepted and every unknown or missing root field yields the expected schema diagnostic.
Identifier boundary and uniqueness cases return exact acceptance or stable schema diagnostics.
Trim and Unicode-scalar length boundaries accept at limit and reject empty, untrimmed, invalid-scalar, and over-limit values.
The one Node Definition shape is accepted and every forbidden or unknown execution field is rejected.
Exactly-one-source Input Bindings derive dataflow; alternate edge, port, transform, and literal shapes are rejected.
Forward references pass; duplicate sources, self/missing references, and cycles produce their exact deterministic diagnostics.
Unused Workflow Inputs fail while no-input, multi-root, disconnected, isolated, and multi-terminal definitions pass.
Equivalent eligible nodes preserve authored tie order and every returned map is identifier-ordered.
Optional defaults and descriptions pass; unsupported Input value and reference forms fail with no coercion.
Every forbidden path form fails invalid_path while exact portable relative paths preserve case and Unicode.
Every allowed Data Contract keyword and JSON root passes; every excluded keyword or invalid combination fails deterministically.
Valid reverse-DNS object extensions round-trip; invalid locations, keys, and non-object values fail without changing execution state.
All independently discoverable errors are returned in path/code order with only the eight normative categories.
Runtime validation and every accepted public Workflow value conform to the published closed-world Workflow schema and dialect.
The indexed public fixtures cover every named valid family, failure family, fixed boundary, and deterministic diagnostic.
